review_kind: AI review; no human review performed

reviewer.independence: Reviewer did not author the validation set or implement the current verifier/workflow, but built the source graph/docs and graph-comparison runner and reviewed the same questions under a prior configuration. Current output review began after this report was frozen. Inline verifier votes were not used as ground truth.
reviewer.study_limitations: AI-team review with visible questions and evidence, familiar regression questions and awareness of run summary; not an external blinded human study.

generator_identity.source: Observed per-call metadata only, without substituting configured identity for unreported model responses.

method: Read all ten accepted answers, all 22 retained claims and their selected exact support quotes, source metadata, expected-answer checks and relevant retrieved passages. No environment files, provider calls or implementation edits were used.

Every substantive clause must be fully supported and correctly qualified by the selected quoted evidence for the claim boolean. Reasonable immediate inferences are allowed; topical similarity, a genuine reference and an inline verifier acceptance are insufficient.

Ordinal faithfulness and citation entailment reflect support and qualification gaps; relevance evaluates the retained answer against the original multipart question, including omissions after filtering. A generic partial-answer notice does not supply omitted information.

All 20 cases receive annotations. Only accepted cited_model_synthesis answers enter these quality means; other generated grader reasons, extracted evidence, clarifications, abstentions and guards are not assigned perfect or zero accepted-answer faithfulness.

Only retained generated_claims enter the supported-claim denominator. Application caution/partial notices do not count as model claims. Claim indices are zero-based positions in accepted generated_claims; draft_claim_index is separate.
Manual review fields in the source report remain unchanged and null. This AI review is separate from human review and from inline verifier decisions.
